verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents facet search explicitly for powering autocomplete/type-ahead interfaces, and its analytics feature tracks search queries, clicks, and conversions that could inform a suggestions strategy, but there is no documented dedicated 'suggestions index' or query-log-driven autocomplete feature (e.g., popular/trending query suggestions) — only facet-value autocomplete and general query analytics. missing for 10: a first-party suggestions/autocomplete-from-search-traffic feature, documentation on building a suggestions index from query logs, and independent evidence of this pattern being used in production.
